subunit: Upon mitochondrial depolarization, associates with the TOM complex and the VDAC2 homodimer; its import into the mitochondria is stalled at the TOM complex. Upon mitochondrial depolarization, interacts with TIMM23. Forms a supercomplex with TOM and TIM23 complexes; PINK1-TOM-TIM23 supercomplex formation requires PINK1 interaction with TOMM20 and TOMM70. The interaction with TOM and TIM23 complexes is critical for PINK1 stabilization at the outer mitochondrial membrane, kinase activation and downstream mitophagy. Interacts with PRKN. Interacts with FBXO7. Forms a complex with PRKN and PARK7. Interacts with NENF
